chunk.delta: Writing the spec for snoozing an issue,
then proposing the split. No code changes on a planning run.

submit.summary: Wrote the spec for snoozing an issue and proposed a two-issue split.
submit.nextStep: A person approves the spec, then the split.

spec.title: Snooze an issue until tomorrow
spec.summary: A member can push an issue's next scheduled run to tomorrow, and the issue shows that it is snoozed.

sections.heading: User stories
items: As a member, I want to snooze an issue, so that an agent does not start it today.
Given an issue in Todo, when I snooze it until tomorrow, then no run is dispatched before tomorrow.

sections.heading: Requirements
items: FR-1: An issue can carry a snooze date.
FR-2: A snoozed issue is not dispatched while the date is in the future.

sections.heading: Success criteria
items: SC-1: A snoozed issue produces no run before its date.

split.summary: Storage first, then the scheduler gate.

issues.title: Add the snooze column and its mutator
issues.goal: Store the snooze date on the issue.

criteria.body: An issue row can hold a snooze date.
A member can set and clear it.

issues.title: Hold a snoozed issue out of dispatch
issues.goal: The orchestrator skips an issue whose snooze date is in the future.

criteria.body: No run is dispatched for an issue snoozed until tomorrow.
